Approximate heap per entry (200,000 entries, after GC):
HashMap ~ 71 bytes/entry (includes shared key + value objects)
TreeMap ~ 64 bytes/entry (includes shared key + value objects)
LinkedHashMap ~ 84 bytes/entry (includes shared key + value objects)
array of values ~ 25 bytes/entry (value objects only; keys shared)
